faults.title: Juddering clutch
faults.description: Some 2016–2021 Sportage cars have been reported with clutch judder. Check for shudder when moving off and ask a workshop to identify the cause before assuming a clutch replacement is required.

faults.title: Engine-computer faults
faults.description: Reports of engine-computer problems exist for this generation of Sportage. If warning lights or running faults appear, have diagnostic codes read and the underlying fault confirmed before repair.
